annotations.title: Publish a coupon on your card

description: For a proved owner: publish a discount on the card and the Atlas coupon feed, shown as stated by the verified owner. Needs title (one sentence), endsAt (ISO date, within a year), url (a page on your domain where it applies), and kind with code, percentOff, amountOff+currency or trialDays as fits. Confirm it every 45 days (atlas_owner_coupon_set) or it stops showing. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

amountOff.description: For kind amount: whole number in minor units (cents)

appliesTo.description: Which plans it covers, up to 400 characters

currency.description: For kind amount: ISO code, e.g. USD

url.description: Page on your domain where it applies

domain.description: The tool's domain as the Atlas lists it, e.g. acme.ai

name: atlas_owner_coupon_add
title: Publish a coupon on your card
